integrity: The proof derives the rank enumerator from path-run ranks, a cyclic transfer matrix, and an exact Pfaffian count on full-support even cycles. The character formula is then obtained from the established class-two character-rank theorem. A standalone exhaustive checker reconstructs the weighted cycle matrices over four finite fields and verifies all displayed rank counts and character sum-of-squares identities.
scientific_limitations: The graphical-group character formula is asserted only for odd finite fields; the matrix rank enumerator is valid in every characteristic.
The theorem treats cycle graphs and does not yet cover arbitrary unicyclic graphs.
An equivalent weighted-cycle rank count may exist in finite-matrix or Pfaffian literature under different terminology.
title: Cycle graphical groups have an explicit character-degree enumerator
